claim: Patchline ships a measured developer-productivity study showing reduced migration review time at scale. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the review time claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make developer-productivity-study-gate`.
